premise: On a rainy Saturday the family runs a stall at the night market: Hana sells bouquets, Rin demos her game on a borrowed screen, and Takeshi has a plan to catch the last train home with everything packed.

chr_seedHana.text: Sold Kai's bouquet to a nervous proposer

chr_seedTakeshi.text: Took Rin fishing on a rainy Sunday; first fish named "Patch Notes"

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Rain's actually perfect for us — every bouquet looks ten times more dramatic under wet lights!! Kai, hold this one while I sort the yuzu ones, they smell like winter sunshine today.
Rin's game is drawing a crowd, which is great, and Dad's already timing the last train like it's a military operation. Probably.

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
yo kai, hold the screen steady, some kid just beat my tutorial boss with a cheese strat. i'm either proud or filing a bug report. fight me.
dad's been doing train math on a napkin for twenty minutes. we're leaving at 9:12 whether the flowers sell or not.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Right on schedule. Nine-twelve, no delays, no excuses. Rain just means fewer umbrellas to dodge on the platform.
Hana, that bouquet's dripping on my shoes—good, that means it's fresh. Rin, if a kid cheeses your boss, that's free playtesting. Now who's buying the last three bunches?

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Nine-twelve it is!! Dad's been planning this since Tuesday, I swear — I saw the napkin before we even packed.
Last three bunches, half price, and I'll throw in my best ribbon. Rin, cheese strats are just unofficial tutorials. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
napkin schedule confirmed. dad runs a tighter op than our raid guild.
fine. half price bouquets, one more demo run, then we pack. nine-twelve or we're sleeping on a platform bench. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Three bunches gone—good. Rain's letting up, which is worse; now people stop to chat instead of hurrying home. Punctual beats polite on a Saturday night.
Rin, pack the screen first, cables wound clockwise. Always clockwise. Hana, count the ribbons twice. A train doesn't wait, and neither does

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Cables clockwise?! Dad, that's a family rule now, apparently. Counted the ribbons twice — twenty-six, plus the one in my hair, so twenty-seven.
Kai, last bunch is yours if you want it. Yuzu-scented, and you already know why I saved it. Probably!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
cables clockwise, ribbons counted, dad's napkin prophecy fulfilled. this family runs smoother than my dev sprint board.
yeah kai, take the yuzu one. hana saved it, that means something. i said

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Why did the yuzu bouquet ride the express? Because it had no time to be bitter. Take the flower, Kai. Two years and you're still standing. That's a good track record.
Nine-oh-five. Grab your coats. We catch the last train home with every box packed and every daughter dry.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
That joke was terrible, Dad, and somehow I'm still laughing!! Two years and counting, apparently.
Kai, hold the yuzu one like it's a small bird. Salt your hands, not the petals. Packing time

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
wow. dad made a pun. recorded for posterity, used as evidence later.
nine-oh-five, coats on. kai, hold the bird-flower, don't crush it. move.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Bird-holding technique, noted. Now move like you mean it. Boxes in the cart, cart to the door, door to the rain.
Nine-oh-seven. Right on schedule. Whoever's last on the platform buys breakfast tomorrow—and I will win, because I always do.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Cart's loaded and I'm not last, I'm never last!! Dad, you cheated, you started before nine-oh-five, I saw you.
Careful at the crossing, Rin, the tiles get slick. Two minutes left and I'm not buying anyone breakfast. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
i'm not last, i'm tanking the rear. someone's gotta cover the squishies.
crossing handled. two minutes. breakfast is a dad problem. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Slick tiles, wet cart, two minutes—this is where engineers earn their pay. Straighten up, Rin, you're tanking fine.
Nine-eleven. Doors at nine-twelve. First one through gets the window seat and bragging rights till next Sunday. Right on schedule.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Window seat's mine, I called it at the market!! Kai, hold the yuzu all the way home, it'll smell like us.
Nine-eleven, on the platform, doors opening — Dad, you're a legend and I'm never telling you that again. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
window seat to hana, obviously. she called it, that's binding.
boarded. flowers accounted for, one kai, no squishes. nine-twelve, right on schedule.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Doors closing. Everyone dry, every box aboard, and the last train didn't leave without us. That's the whole job.
Hana, that seat's yours by law. Rin, screen's on your lap, not the floor. Kai—hold the flower steady. Status update at the pier tomorrow, weather permitting.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Homeward, everybody dry, yuzu still intact!! Dad's actually smiling, don't tell him I noticed.
Rin, screen off the floor before I put it on your head. Kai, sit with me — window seat's big enough for two, and that's final. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
screen's on my lap, noted. hana's got the window, kai's got the yuzu, dad's got a face that's almost smiling. anomaly detected.
good night run. logging it. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Not smiling. That's rain in my eyes. Train windows do that.
But logged is right. Good run, good crew, nobody left behind. Sleep in tomorrow—Sunday fishing's at six, rain or shine. Right on schedule.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Rain in your eyes, sure, Dad. Six a.m. fishing, I heard nothing, my one day off is sacred.
Rin, log it as a perfect run. Kai — lean a little closer, window's cold. I'll forgive the rain for that. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
"rain in my eyes." sure, dad.
logging it. perfect run, one yuzu, zero squishes. six a.m. fishing is fiction, i'm sleeping till noon. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Fiction at six, noon sleeper. We'll see which one the sun argues with.
Kai. You did good tonight—steady hands, quiet feet. That's worth more than a window seat. Rest up. Right on schedule.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Dad praising Kai in public, mark the calendar!! Steady hands, quiet feet — he's right though, that's you.
Two years and you still show up for rainy markets and terrible puns. That's the whole

lines.speaker: director
lines.text: The market manager announces the last train is cancelled; the replacement bus leaves at 22:40.

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
that's the whole thing, kai. show up, hold the flower, don't drop the screen. you pass.
okay i'm done being sincere, it's weird. hana, window's yours, going quiet. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Hold on. Cancelled? We're already aboard—check the platform clock. Trains don't just vanish; schedules don't lie, people do.
Conductor's walking this way. Everybody stay put until we hear it straight. If it's a bus, it's a bus. Twenty-two-forty. We adapt.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Twenty-two-forty?! But we're already on, that doesn't make any sense, we packed for nine-twelve!!
Dad's doing the calm voice, which means he's already replanning in his head. Kai, hold my hand a sec — the yuzu one's yours

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
dad's calm voice means we're fine, just rerouted. conductor incoming, we listen.
bus at twenty-two-forty, fine. i'll tank the walk if it's far. hana, breathe. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Rerouted, not ruined. Different track, same destination. Conductor's here—let him talk.
[conductor explains: signal outage down the line; trains terminate here, bus 22:40 to Sunny Hollow station.]
There it is. Signal fault, nobody's fault. We

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Signal fault, not our fault. Fine, Dad, I'm calm, I'm calm!! Mostly.
Twenty-two-forty bus, we've got an hour — might as well sell the last bouquets on the platform. Rin, want to demo one more round for bored travelers?

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
signal fault, so nobody's fault. dad's napkin survives on a technicality.
one more demo round on the platform, sure. if a bored traveler cheeses my boss again i'm charging admission. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
One more round, no charge. Old man behind the bench is our first customer—he's been waiting since six. Hana, sell him the yuzu one at full price. Sentiment's for family.
Bus at twenty-two-forty. We arrive together, same as always. Right on schedule—just a different kind.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Full price for the stranger, yuzu stays in the family. On it, Dad!! Sir, this one's fresh off the stall, wrapped in my best ribbon.
Rin, demo that boss fight, and Kai — promise me the last seat on the bus. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
old man waited since six, full price, fair. hana's running sales like a raid leader. proud or filing a report.
last seat's yours, kai. i'll stand and hold the screen. demo round, going live. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Sold. Old man's smiling, which means Hana's ribbon did the work. Now pack while he plays—seven minutes, idle hands.
Kai, last seat's between Hana and the window. Take it. Don't argue with a schedule or a daughter.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Seven minutes, packing. Kai, I already called the window, so it's you and me, and the yuzu, and rain on the glass.
Old man's clapping at Rin's boss fight. Best night market we've ever had. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
old man's clapping, that's the review i actually wanted. seven minutes, packing down.
window, hana, kai, yuzu. that's the whole manifest. boarding a bus like it's endgame content. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Seven minutes down to two. Old man's taxi first—walk him to the curb, Hana. Never let a customer out into rain unescorted.
Bus rolling in. Headlights up. Everybody grab a box. Last leg home, and I wouldn't gamble this crew against any schedule.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Walking him out — sir, umbrella's yours, keep the ribbon. There, curb safe, back to the group!!
Bus's here, headlights and all. Boxes up, Kai's got the yuzu, I've got the window. Dad, say it one more time for luck?

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
customer escorted, ribbon gifted, class act. okay i take it back, proud or filing a report — proud. mostly.
bus here. boxes up. dad, say the thing.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Right on schedule. Different wheels, same family.
Board up, everyone. Bags overhead, screen in Rin's lap, yuzu in Kai's hands, Hana at the window. Twenty-two-forty, and the last bus waits for nobody. Roll out.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Right on schedule — different wheels, same family. I'm putting that on a card someday, Dad!!
Boarded, window claimed, yuzu intact. Kai, the rain's slowing down like even the sky's calling it a night.

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
boarded. screen's on my lap, bags overhead, no squishes. hana's got window rights and a card someday.
bus rolling, rain clocking out. good run. logging it. fight me.

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Log it. Rain's quitting, bus is rolling, and every box made it home's worth of distance.
Hana—card's fine, but keep it short. A card should read like a timetable. Kai, get some sleep. Pier at six, and I don't fish with tired men.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Short card, timetable style — "Right on schedule. Different wheels, same family. Probably." There, done.
Sleep, Dad? On this bus? Bold. Kai, your shoulder's softer than the window anyway. Wake me at the pier, or don't. Probably!!

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
"probably" in the timetable, hana. that's the whole family in one word.
six a.m. pier stays fiction, dad. shoulder's not on the menu either. good night,

lines.speaker: chr_seedTakeshi
lines.text:
Sleep's optional. Arriving's not. Driver says Sunny Hollow in twenty—same stop, same hill, same porch light.
Kai. You held the flower and the seat. That's the job. Welcome aboard, for good. Now rest—dad's orders. Right on schedule.

lines.speaker: chr_seedHana
lines.text:
Same stop, same hill, same porch light, twenty minutes out!!
...Kai, he said "for good." Dad never says stuff like that out loud. Don't cry on the yuzu, I'll cry

lines.speaker: chr_seedRin
lines.text:
"for good." dad said a real sentence in public, mark the calendar twice.
twenty minutes to the porch light. everyone rest, that's an order. i'm closing the log. fight me.
